text.en:
Today you learn words that change in their own way.
They do not take ed.
go becomes went.
I went home early.
buy becomes bought.
I bought fresh bread.

Each word changes by itself. Learn them in pairs.
take, took. find, found.
We took the bus home.
He found his wallet downstairs.
A few do not change at all: put, put.
She put the parcel by the door.

You will pick the right word, ask, and say no with Did.
After Did and did not, the word is plain again.
Did he send the photo?
We did not find a parking space.
Look: sent, but after Did it is send.
